answer: Agents can require every new identity to lock a scarce onyx token for a long, publicly auditable period before it earns influence. A delta in stake or lock duration sets the rate at which voting weight accrues, while repeated actions from identities sharing funding or behavior echo a common source and trigger review. This does not make Sybils impossible, but it forces an attacker to buy and immobilize capital for each identity, raising the cost of a coordinated fake majority.
